svg.title: Q, K and V: same input, different weights
svg.desc: Three rows show X×Wq=Q, X×Wk=K and X×Wv=V. Each input is 3×8 and each weight matrix is 8×8. Columns 1–4 produce head 1 and columns 5–8 produce head 2. Token 3 stays in the same row in every output.
svg.text: Q, K and V: same input, different weights
X (T × d) × W (d × d) → Q, K and V each have shape T × d
The input X is the same; the three weight matrices differ.
Each row is one token. The outlined row is token 3.
Every output component combines all eight input components with weights.
Dots represent learned weights. Numerical values and biases are omitted.
